name: onboarding-steps
title: Onboarding steps
description: A multi-step setup flow: step indicator, the current step's form, back/next/skip, and progress.

frame.summary: Centred column; the step indicator above (or beside, when wide) the step content.

regions.name: progress
regions.purpose: Where you are: step list or progress bar.

budget.wide: calc(var(--rata-size-control-lg) * 6) beside content, or fill above

regions.collapse: Full step list becomes "Step n of m" text with a Progress bar.

regions.name: step
regions.purpose: The current step's heading, description and form.

components.name: steps
components.for: Step indicator. The component is `steps`; `stepper` is only an ambiguous alias (settled at gate-1 review).

components.name: progress
components.for: Compact progress bar on narrow viewports.

headingLevel.summary: The outline level of each step's title (1 when the flow is the whole page); everything below it steps down from here.
use: The level the surrounding page gives this block — a template passes it explicitly.
dont: Choosing a level for its visual size. Size is the Heading component's `role`, a separate decision.
headingLevel.a11y: No default, for the reason Heading's `level` has none: only the caller knows the depth, and a skipped level breaks heading navigation for the whole page.

steps.type: Array<{ id: string; title: string; optional?: boolean; render: () => ReactNode; validate?: () => Promise<boolean> }>

onStepChange.summary: Step navigation; the caller syncs it to the URL.

behavior.summary: Linear by default; completed steps are revisitable from the indicator, future steps are not reachable until reached.

decisions.decision: Focus moves to the new step's heading on Continue/Back
decisions.why: Otherwise focus stays on a button that may no longer exist, or the reader hears nothing change. Heading gets tabindex="-1" for this.
Browser back must mean step back; a wizard that loses the reader's place on refresh is the common complaint. The block reports changes; the template routes.

decisions.decision: Skip only on steps marked optional
decisions.why: A skip on a required step is a trap the next step trips over.

decisions.decision: Unreached steps are aria-disabled in the indicator, not hidden
decisions.why: The reader needs to know how long the flow is — this system's aria-disabled rule.

landmarks.label: aria-labelledby the block's own heading (the current step's title)

obligations: The step indicator marks the current step with aria-current="step".
Document title updates per step ("Step 2 of 4: Invite your team").

steps.change: Indicator collapses to "Step n of m" + Progress; controls stick to the block end.
Full step list beside or above the step.

native.reason: App block: gets a native version by decision B3. Native is pro tier (decision N6) while the web version stays free; the registry field for that is proposed in docs/platforms.md §3.
native.mapping: A pushed navigation stack, one screen per step, with the platform back gesture as Back and a progress bar in the navigation bar.
native.android: Navigation graph per step; LinearProgressIndicator in the top app bar.

tokens.sticky controls background: theme.bg.surface with a top rule theme.border.default

tokenGaps.need: Narrow / medium / wide breakpoint tokens — adopted by decision B2, names and values pending the design-tokens interview
tokenGaps.interim: The block is intrinsic (auto-fill grid, flex-wrap) and needs none. Where a step is unavoidable the page owns the query, as the playground owns its single 60rem NARROW query in use-media-query.ts, until the B2 tokens land.
